name: Kuwait Towers
description: The Kuwait Towers (1979, VBB / Sune Lindström & Malene Bjørn): main tower 187 m with a restaurant sphere and a revolving observation sphere, second tower 147 m (water), third tower 113 m (floodlights). Spheres clad in enamelled steel discs. Dimensions measured from the perspective-corrected Wikipedia photo scaled to the published heights (±5%).
